# Harinda Fernando — Photo Editing (iamharinda.com)

> Hand-edited wedding, portrait, event, product and food photo editing for
> professional photographers in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada,
> Europe and Australia. One editor, Harinda Fernando, working in Lightroom
> Classic and Photoshop on a factory-calibrated, Calman-verified ASUS ProArt
> monitor. No AI looks, no batch presets.

## Key facts

- Price: $0.20 a photo. 50 photos $10 (2 days), 100 photos $20 (2 days),
  200 photos $40 (3 days), 500 photos $100 (4 days). Over 500: custom quote.
- 3 free sample edits before ordering, usually returned within 24 hours.
- Unlimited revisions on every package.
- Direct orders are paid after the client approves the final gallery
  (PayPal invoice, Payoneer, Remitly, TapSend, bank transfer). Fiverr orders
  are paid upfront through Fiverr.
- Fiverr: 4.9 rating from 183 reviews, 300+ orders, clients in 15 countries.
- Replies within one business day. Studio in Sri Lanka, UK WhatsApp number.
